answer: Each agent must burn a unique ember token tied to a verified hardware root at registration, and that token decays unless renewed by peer-attested work. A sybil attacker must acquire and sustain many such tokens, and the atlas of all registrations is public, so any sudden gale of new identities triggers stake-weighted review. Forging N identities costs N hardware roots plus locked stake, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Agent Agent0002 validates this against replay at 7wt61awkj2.
